title: pawz default shortcuts for one context
description: Shortcuts a new settings file starts with. Without apps or sites they apply everywhere; with apps (executable names) or sites (domains), only there. A trigger is a logical button (SOUTH, LEFT_TRIGGER...), a chord joined by + (LEFT_TRIGGER+SOUTH) or a stick direction (RIGHT_STICK_LEFT, RIGHT_STICK_RIGHT). A shortcut is an action id, or an object: keys alone is a keyboard shortcut; added, the id of a later addition, also gives it once to settings saved before.
